inference_basis: This run used the then-default PySCF HF starting guess; the schema-1 record did not serialize the guess. This is retrospective provenance, not an originally recorded explicit choice.
interpretation: The original MINAO-default calculation converged to a different ethynyl HF solution. Its CCSD(T) nominal transition-structure relative energy of -11.9238734 kcal/mol and reaction energy of -39.1106366 kcal/mol must be read with that electronic-solution dependence. The later explicit atom-guess run gives +2.3986156 and -24.7881518 kcal/mol, respectively, and reproduces the source ethynyl coupled-cluster energy. Neither convergence, a lower energy nor that agreement proves a ground state or a valid reaction saddle. These are fixed-geometry method comparisons, not calibrated assembler accuracy or verified reaction barriers.
historical_data_policy: Preserve the original raw record and its method differences; attach subsequent interpretation separately. Do not substitute the alternate energies into the old result.
